nutrition.bulking: Eat 300-500 calories above maintenance. Focus on protein (1.6-2.2g/kg), complex carbs, healthy fats.
nutrition.cutting: Eat 300-500 calories below maintenance. High protein, moderate carbs, low fats. Maintain strength training.
nutrition.maintenance: Eat at maintenance calories. Balance macros for performance and recovery.
nutrition.pre_workout: Carbs + protein 1-2 hours before workout. Example: banana + protein shake or oatmeal.
nutrition.post_workout: Protein + carbs within 2 hours after workout. Example: whey protein + dextrose or chicken + rice.
